changes_forbidden: dataset items, gold labels, pairs, or prompts
models, adapters, output contracts, decoding, or request limit
changes_permitted: new freeze timestamp and Git commit
new request schedule hashes induced only by new lane identifiers
resource_exhaustion_rule: Ordinary service, syntax, schema, semantic, adapter, and rate-limit failures remain incorrect in the complete end-to-end denominator. If a terminal provider error explicitly states that the shared subscription quota or usage allowance is exhausted, at least 20 scheduled cells remain, and every later cell is a transport failure, the complete hosted replacement is ineligible for model-efficacy reporting. In that case, retain only a redacted full-study exclusion receipt; never select a successful subset.
selection_reason: Repeat the unchanged complete hosted protocol after the user replenished the shared subscription allowance; the predecessor was excluded in full because quota failures persisted through the end of its frozen schedule.
